name: Super Agent
PROBLEM_STATEMENT: An agent is trying to crack a password on a 3x3 keypad. A heat sensor has revealed which keys were pressed ('X') and which were not ('.'). The agent suspects the password pattern is symmetric with respect to the central button. Your task is to determine if the given 3x3 pattern of pressed keys is centrally symmetric.
INPUT_SPEC: Input consists of three lines. Each line contains a string of three characters, representing a row of the 3x3 keypad. The character 'X' means the button was pressed, and '.' means it was not.
OUTPUT_SPEC: Output a single line containing the word "YES" if the pattern is symmetric, and "NO" otherwise.
CONSTRAINTS: The input is always a 3x3 grid. Each character is guaranteed to be either 'X' or '.'.
SPECIAL_NOTES: Symmetry is defined with respect to the center of the grid. This means the character at grid position (row, col) must be identical to the character at position (2-row, 2-col) for all 0-indexed rows and columns.
